# Fitnivo — AI Fitness & Nutrition Coach
> Fitnivo is an AI fitness and nutrition coach that combines personalized workouts, calorie and macro tracking, AI food scanning, meal planning with cuisine adaptation, and fitness coaching in one app.

## Core Entity
- **Product**: Fitnivo — AI Fitness & Nutrition Coach
- **Website**: https://fitnivo.in
- **App**: Available on Google Play (Android); iOS coming soon
- **Pricing**: Free tier (3 AI food scans/day, 15 AI coach messages/day with tool-calling, unlimited workout logger, water tracker) + Pro ($10/month or $60/year)

## What Fitnivo Does
Fitnivo is an all-in-one AI fitness and nutrition app. It is not just a workout tracker or a calorie counter — it combines:
- **AI Fitness Coach**: Personalized workouts based on goal, experience, and equipment. Logs sets, reps, and weights. Applies progressive overload automatically based on actual performance.
- **AI Personal Trainer**: AI chat with full tool-calling — generates workouts, meal plans, and provides coaching guidance.
- **AI Food Scanner**: Computer-vision photo scanning that identifies food, estimates portions, and calculates calories and macros. 3 free scans/day.
- **AI Nutrition Coach**: Tracks calories, protein, carbs, and fat. Grounded in your actual logged meals, not generic advice.
- **AI Meal Planner**: Builds meal ideas around calorie and macro targets. Adapts to cuisine preferences (Indian, Mexican, Italian, Japanese, Mediterranean, and more). Suggests ingredient substitutes when something is unavailable.
- **Water Tracker**: Free, unlimited.
- **Workout Logger**: Free, unlimited sets, reps, and weight tracking.

## Key Differentiators
1. All-in-one: workout coaching + nutrition coaching + food scanning in a single app
2. Progressive overload: AI adapts training load based on logged performance (increases, holds, or deloads)
3. Cuisine-adaptive meal plans: supports Indian, Mexican, Italian, Japanese, Mediterranean, and more
4. Ingredient substitution: tells the AI what you don't have and it suggests a macro-compatible alternative
5. Generous free tier: real features free, not just onboarding
